character_anchors.prompt_summary: A cute bipedal anthropomorphic young calf standing upright, roughly waist-height to an adult bull. He has soft warm amber-yellow short fur, an oversized round head with large expressive black glossy eyes, and a broad pink muzzle. Two short, blunt conical horns sprout from the top of his head between floppy rounded ears. He wears light sky-blue denim overalls with brass buckle straps over his stubby torso.

A sturdy, broad-shouldered bipedal adult bull standing tall on two legs. He has rich dark orange-brown short coat fur, thick furrowed brows, and a small patch of dark brown stubble along his jawline. A pair of massive, sweeping horns curves outward and upward proudly from his head. He wears a rugged dark brown leather utility vest over his muscular chest.

An ultra-thin, tiny white snake as slender as a chopstick. Its body is smooth, milky-white, and semi-translucent like polished jade, with a soft pale-pink underside. It has two tiny black sesame-seed round eyes on a blunt rounded head. It often perches by holding its upper torso straight upright like a tiny stalk.

A palm-sized stylized cartoon songbird covered in vibrant crimson-red plumage. It features a perky pointed feather crest atop its head, a sharp slender bright-yellow beak, and long split tail feathers. Its two small black spindly claws are nimble and compact.

location_anchors.prompt_summary: A rolling green grassy hillside on the sunny perimeter of a fantasy woodland. Dotted throughout the lush grass are clusters of small sunny-yellow wildflowers and a massive, rounded moss-dappled slate-gray boulder. In the background rise gently rolling green hills and whimsical stylized cartoon conifer trees under bright blue afternoon skies.

A dense enchanting woodland interior traversed by a shallow, crystal-clear bubbling creek. Both banks are lined with towering broadleaf trees with thick mossy roots gripping the moist earth, surrounded by low ferns and lush emerald undergrowth. Dappled afternoon sunlight filters through the leafy canopy creating luminous golden patterns on the rippling water surface.
